For every physical query i in core j, with mu=E g_j,t=ghat_j({i}), h=A+z_j D and other-core Fourier coefficients Ahat_W,Dhat_W, the EXACT signed drift is mean C_child-C_parent=q_j L(mu,t)-sum_W L(Ahat_W+mu Dhat_W,t Dhat_W). Each L>=0, and Booleanity gives L(mu,t)<=(2/ln2)Inf_i(g_j). Therefore mean C_child-C_parent<=(2/ln2)Inf_i(F)<=3Inf_i(F), with strict second inequality when that influence is positive. For EVERY real K>=0 and each full inner stopping hull rho_j of(H-KI)_+, the fixed-partition potential U_K=C+kappa I(F)+sum_j q_j rho_j, kappa=2/ln2 or3, is nonnegative, superharmonic under every physical query and majorizes(H(F)-KI(F))_+. Already supplied credit at least U_K pays arbitrary admissions/queries/stops preserving actual arriving credit, all nonnegative credit owners, signed debit labels, complete terminals and spent donors. The rational6 source potential exceeds the new rational3 one by exactly3I at every state; this is reduced necessary headroom, not a new donor. No universal INITIAL influence price is proved: singleton physical cores still give U_K=H(F)+kappa I(F).
